summary: End-to-end test of Module Access generalization (Finance/HR/Sales/Banking/Accounting/Social Work/Restricted) + Manager-loses-implicit-finance behavior change. 59/59 pytest pass (47 regression smokes + 12 new). All frontend testids present; HR moved from Admin to Finance sidebar section confirmed.

minor.issue: `access_expired` field is only included when an explicit grant exists AND has expired. For implicit/no-grant rows the key is omitted. Spec/review listed it as one of the enriched fields. Legacy finance shim does default it to False — inconsistent. Recommend always returning access_expired:false when not expired so the frontend can rely on the key.

verified_behaviors: PUT /api/admin/module-access/users/{id} {module:hr, granted:true, ttl_days:30} -> persists, re-list shows access_effective=true
CRITICAL: Manager without grant -> 403 on /api/financial/donations; after PUT module=finance granted=true -> 200 (auto-finance for Managers removed as designed)
Frontend /admin: module-access-manager-card present, legacy finance-access-manager-card removed
Dialog shows all 7 chips (module-chip-finance|hr|sales|banking|accounting|social_work|restricted), module-picker + module-access-search present, default chip = Finance
HR chip switches list scope; Implicit (role) badge shown for Director/Admin; Grant button shown for Staff/Manager/Guest/Member
Nested grant dialog has Permanent/30/90/Custom TTL chips, module-grant-ttl + module-grant-confirm testids present
Sidebar Admin section: Staff & Users, Campuses, Financial APIs, Email Templates, Settings, Audit Trail, Privacy & GDPR (HR removed)
Sidebar Finance section (source confirmed Layout.jsx L70-81): Financial, Accounting, Banking, HR & Payroll, Approvals, Marketplace — each with module: key for per-module gating
action_items: Optional polish: make /api/admin/module-access/users always include access_expired (default false) for shape consistency with the legacy finance shim.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.py / admin.py module gate looks consistent: has_module_access('finance') delegate + Manager removed from FINANCE_PRIVILEGED_ROLES — verified end-to-end (403 -> 200 after grant).
Legacy /admin/finance-access/* shim correctly delegates to module='finance' and preserves old key names — back-compat clean.
Layout.jsx Finance section uses module: keys consistently; Admin section properly drops HR. PRIVILEGED_ROLES excludes Manager (matches backend).
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_mgr_<ts>@example.com Manager user during test; teardown deletes it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Module access UI is at /admin via module-access-manager-card. Test ids in dialog: module-picker, module-access-search, module-chip-<key>, module-access-row-<userid>, module-grant-<userid>, module-revoke-<userid>, module-grant-ttl, module-grant-confirm. Manager role no longer has automatic finance access — anything depending on Manager auto-access to finance endpoints must grant explicitly.
